candidateObjectiveEnglish: Describe not-yet readiness, non-understanding and absence in English.
grammarExplanationEnglish: English never, nobody and nothing express negation without an extra negative: We never work on a wet roof; There's nothing in the wheelbarrow. For standard English, do not say We don't never work or There isn't nothing. Yet goes at the end here: The roof isn't ready yet.
